verdict.rationale: Apify's web-scraper Actor supports startUrls plus maxCrawlPages, letting a single API call crawl a whole site and return page content, and Crawlee (Apify's crawling library) is built for full-site recursive crawling. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on benchmark of a full multi-page site crawl completing reliably, and no explicit documentation of link-following/depth config in the evidence pack beyond maxCrawlPages.
